Lemma B.2
nodes.statement: If the events of Theorem 2.1 and Lemma B.1 hold, then the optimal hyperparameter $u^\star$ is never removed after it is introduced, i.e. $u^* \in U_{t}$ for all $t=t_0, \dots, T$, where $t_0$ is the first iteration, where the  optimal  hyperparameter $u^\star$ is introduced.

nodes.name: Lemma B.3
nodes.statement: Assume the event of Lemma B.2 holds. For any  $u \in A$ that was selected in line 3 at least once after $t_0$ and any time step $t=t_0,\dots,T$ we must have that $R^{u}(|S_t^u|) \le R^{u^\star}(|S_t^{u^\star}|) + 2B^{u^\star}$.
